scripts.start: cd frontend && npm i && npm run build && mkdir -p ../src/main/resources/static && rm -rf ../src/main/resources/static/* && cp -r out/* ../src/main/resources/static/ && cd .. && ./mvnw spring-boot:run
scripts.docker: docker build -t nexus:latest . && docker stop nexus-app 2>/dev/null || true && docker rm nexus-app 2>/dev/null || true && docker run -d --name nexus-app -p 8080:8080 nexus:latest
